description: Feuerwehren der Gemeinde Floh-Seligenthal is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data set contains the fire brigade locations of the municipality of Floh-Seligenthal. It is a secondary database. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Fire brigades of the municipality of Floh-Seligenthal" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include REGI, GOVE, Thüringen, opendata, Feuerwehrstützpunkte, Feuerwehren. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
